name: feature_manager_create_thunk

ownership.argument: Borrowed 16-byte host; returns a FeatureManagerQjs pointer, not a raw registry. Registration uses *(manager+4). This direct flash entry is NOT hookable by current Supervisor without an actual RAM dispatch slot; FPB enum value is not implemented and the thunk contains an unrelocatable BL.

provenance.source: 0xC86236C PUSH {r7,lr}; ADD r7,sp,#0; BL 0xC8660E4; POP {r7,pc}. Real AIOTJS caller 0xC911306 stores returned manager into its runtime+0xA4 at 0xC91130E. Inner constructor 0xC8656D8 stores raw registry at manager+4.
